answer: The spiral is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the pigment. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tundra of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
